description: This file is a script for analyzing and validating extension plugin SDK boundary violations within a project. It reads source files, classifies module specifiers, and produces inventories of dependency violations according to different modes, supporting baseline comparisons and reporting.

methods.name: collectExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects an inventory of dependency boundary violations based on the specified mode for parsed extension source files.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline inventory file for a given mode, returning an empty array if the file does not exist.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Computes the difference between expected and actual inventories to identify missing or unexpected entries.

methods.name: runExtensionPluginSdkBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Performs the boundary check according to the specified mode and outputs the results, optionally in JSON format, and manages baseline diffing.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that executes the boundary check script, handles exit codes.
